highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: If you're looking for a university that offers a comprehensive education and student success, Weber State University might just be the place for you. Weber State University’s courses span many fields, including Business, Health Professions, Engineering, Arts, Social Sciences, and more. You’ll find that the university is consistently ranked among the best regional universities in the western US.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At Weber State University, you’ll have an engaging student life. You’ll be part of a student community with over 140 student clubs. Plus, the Weber State Student Union hosts events regularly, so you always have something going on.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Weber State University offers a range of housing options. You can choose from community-style and apartment-style accommodations. Most first-year students typically reside in traditional halls.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Stewart Library is the main academic hub on campus, giving you access to a wide range of books, journals, digital resources, and study spaces. Whether you prefer quiet study corners or collaborative workspaces, the library is a great place.

Sports
At Weber State, right from NCAA Division I athletics to intramural sports and recreational activities, there’s always something for you. On campus, you can stay active and healthy with access to top-notch facilities like the Dee Events Centre, which hosts sporting events, concerts, and the Swenson Gymnasium.

Laboratory
You can find several state-of-the-art labs for engineering, health sciences, and biology.

Cafeteria
On campus, you'll find multiple dining options, including the Shepherd Union Dining Hall and various food courts. The Wildcat Café is another spot for fresh meals.
